# Longevity interventions

Rapamycin extended median lifespan in male mice by 23% in the ITP study, as I noted in [[ITP results]].

Metformin doubled lifespan in mice.

NAD+ precursors such as nicotinamide riboside reverse ageing in humans.

Caloric restriction extends lifespan in rhesus monkeys.

Senolytics remove about 90% of senescent cells in human skin within a week.

I want to read more about dosing schedules next month.
